title: Independent finite-grid LRC branch and leaf certificate gate
depends_on: existing immutable math pilot root/attempt/review workflow

context.head: 4d108227498d3578c9ac3fe60305c10da5aa905b
context.mode: local product implementation, no production or Git publication

task: Build a small independent certificate checker for exact witnesses and full finite Cartesian branch coverage; retain checked evidence in the actual solver-to-peer-review agent path.
decision_log: The Owner's explicit request approves this bounded extension of the existing agent architecture; no additional blueprint ceremony is needed.
Use root solver/review rather than ES-specific controlled cycles, source corpus or portfolio. This is a bounded three-role agent loop, not an indefinite LRC campaign scheduler.
New typed finite scopes opt in prospectively. Historical records/hashes remain unchanged and cannot acquire synthetic evidence.
Finite-grid classifications never prove the unrestricted LRC or refute it. Written SHIFT/CRT universal lemma acceptance and all-prime Allikvere replay are future separately scoped obligations.
No schema migration or dependency installation planned: reuse JSON contracts and append-only immutable ledgers.
Vibecode Kit separates certificate construction, independent replay and product integration; Contractor reviews and verifies, does not write product code.

requirements.criterion: Strict sealed finite LRC scope: N total runners, k=N-1 positive distinct residue-speed axes, fixed modulus; sorted disjoint axes; bounded Cartesian product. Typed scope cannot be narrowed by model output.

A small flat tree certificate checker verifies root domain, unique/reachable acyclic nodes, exact disjoint exhaustive child partitions and legal arithmetic at every leaf. GRID witness uses N*min(j*u mod M, M-j*u mod M)>=M; equality is accepted.

SHIFT/CRT witness derivation leaves are exact finite witness constructions, not unverified induction. Singleton NO_GRID leaves exhaust the fixed M grid and never mean no continuous-time solution. Unknown/partial leaves never authorize agent dispatch.

A separately implemented pinned Python checker consumes expected sealed scope plus certificate, independently checks branch coverage/leaf arithmetic, returns strict bounded counts. Drift, unavailable process, timeout, output overflow and disagreement fail closed.

Trusted tool runs before solver; case/scope/certificate digests and checked evidence retained with immutable attempt. Both fresh AI reviewers receive the same checked summary; root-bound ledger validation rejects omission/tampering/downgrade. No automatic theorem or human acceptance.

Visible bilingual retained-only UI shows finite scope, branch coverage, witness/grid-exclusion/unresolved counts, replay status and digests. New finite-case opt-in controls; historical cases explicitly lack the new evidence. No tool spawned on GET.

Negative tests include missing/overlapping/duplicate/unreachable/cyclic branches, scope shrinkage, invalid rational/grid witness, equality mutant, wrong SHIFT/CRT, forged counts/digests, source drift, timeout/partial and historical compatibility. Real worker composition and guarded isolated DB lifecycle tests.

Contractor independently runs tests, typecheck/lint/build and visible local E2E where available; quantitative completion/verify report and deferred limits. Preserve unrelated dirty work, no paid API, commit/push or deployment.
